newsitem.title: PERU: IMF mission to asess Peru's macroeconomic goals.
newsitem.headline: IMF mission to asess Peru's macroeconomic goals.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund mission will arrive in Lima Tuesday to assess the government's fourth quarter 1996 macroeconomic record, Central Bank officials said.

The mission is due to meet Central Bank and Economy Ministry officials to assess key indicators of the Peruvian economy such as inflation, gross domestic product (GDP), trade balance, and the balance of payments.
In a three-year letter of intent signed with the IMF in June 1996, Peru committed itself to economic growth of between three and 4.5 percent and inflation of between 9.5 and 11.5 percent in 1996.
However, it narrowly missed both targets, with growth ending the year at 2.8 percent and annual inflation reaching 11.84 percent.
